about: Windows 11 numbers from documented Win32 behaviour and widely published defaults, each with how it was derived. Tier B: good, to be cross-checked.

desktop_icon_grid.derivation: HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics IconSpacing and IconVerticalSpacing both default to -1125; the registry stores twips (15 per pixel at 96 DPI), so 1125 / 15 = 75 px. Several user guides give -1125 as the default; the pixel value is derived, not stated by Microsoft.
desktop_icon_grid.caveat: one user report gives -1710 horizontal on Windows 10 before 1607; Windows 11 is reported as -1125 for both

approved_shell_reference.source: the user's approved visual reference for the shell, built into the shell already (docs/MIHAWK_OS.md)

to_verify.desktop_icon_sizes_px: Large 96, Medium 48, Small 32 are the commonly cited sizes of the desktop's View menu; not yet confirmed by an official source
to_verify.caption_button_px: 46 x 32 is widely quoted (Tier C until measured)
